title: Surreal Fractured Urn
description: A large cracked purple urn with a serene closed-eyed female face sits at the center of a swirling vortex. Red and teal liquid drips from its fractures while a green snake, a smiling black sun-like face, and a turtle with a red creature emerge from it, surrounded by fish, palm trees, and coral against a black and white spiral background.
prompt: A surreal painting of a large cracked purple ceramic urn featuring a serene woman's face with closed eyes, red and teal paint dripping from fractures. A green snake coils around the rim, a happy black sun character and a turtle with a fuzzy red creature emerge from cracks. Set in a swirling black and white vortex background filled with fish, red handprints, playing cards, palm trees and coral at the base.
